title: Screenshots and traces from an earlier Playwright run vanish when a second run starts
symptoms: test-results from the first CI step are gone before the upload step
Running projects as separate commands leaves only the last project's artifacts
cause: Playwright Test empties outputDir at the start of every run. Several invocations that share the default test-results folder delete each other's files.
fix: Give each invocation its own outputDir, or upload artifacts after each step.
apply:
npx playwright test --project=chromium --output=test-results/chromium
npx playwright test --project=firefox --output=test-results/firefox
